Text:
# NOSOCOMIAL PNEUMONIA WITH LEGIONELLA PNEUMOPHILA

Intravenous therapy preferred initially until signs and symptoms improve.

# Duration of therapy

Treat for 7 to 10 days based on response. Consider longer courses of therapy in immunocompromised patients with severe illness. ID consultation is recommended if immunocompromise.

---

References:

- Jasper AS. Clin Infect Dis. 2021:72(11):1979
- Phin N. Lancet Infectious Diseases 2014, 14:1011
- Sanford: Pneumonia Legionella
- Up-to-date website
Therapy:
## Recommend starting with parenteral therapy

Azithromycin 500 mg IV q24h M

< OR >
Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R,DI

## Switch to oral to complete therapy

Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h M

< OR >
Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h R,DI
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU ABX NOSOCOMIAL L. PNEUMOPHILA
